labels.label:
Filter Edits: This processor filters out anything but actual page edits. To achieve this, it's running a query that 
selects all FlowFiles (events) of the type "edit".

Merge Edit Events: These processors are configured to merge at least 100 records into one flowfile to avoid writing 
lots of small files. 
The MaxBinAge property is set to 2 minutes which makes the processors merge records after two minutes even 
if less than 100 records have arrived.

Convert JSON to AVRO: This processor converts the JSON response to AVRO format. It uses RecordReaders
 and RecordWriters to accomplish this. It infers the JSON schema starting from the recent changes field.

Get Recent Wikipedia Changes: This processor calls the Wikipedia API to retrieve the latest changes. 
Explore its configuration to see how query parameters are passed in.

Write To File: These processors write the filtered, routed edit events to two different locations on the local disk. 
In CDF-PC, you would typically not write to local disk but replace these processors with 
processors that resemble your destination system (Kafka, Database, Object Store etc.)

Route On Content Size: This processor uses two SQL statements to separate edit events that resulted in a longer 
article from edit events that resulted in a shorter article.

This flow retrieves the most recent changes from Wikipedia, 
converts the response from JSON to AVRO, 
filters out any changes that are not edits before routing 
edit events based on whether they added or removed
 content to the article. 
Ultimately this flow writes files to the local disk.
